item.title: 1.40.8b1
item.description:
⚠️ BETA RELEASE WARNING

This is an unstable pre-release version intended for testing purposes only.

✨ New Features

  • Back up and restore settings as a JSON file
    • Open Settings > General > Backup & Restore, then click "Export Settings…" or "Import Settings…"
    • Keep a copy in iCloud Drive or a dotfiles repository, or use it to move your setup to another Mac
    • The exported file name defaults to "DockDoor Settings <date>.json"
    • Importing asks for confirmation first, shows how many settings the backup contains, replaces all your current settings, and restarts DockDoor
    • If the backup came from a different DockDoor version, settings that no longer exist are ignored and new settings keep their defaults
    • Searching Settings for "backup", "export", "import", "restore", "sync", "dotfiles", or "iCloud" finds these options

🔧 Improvements & Stability

  • Clear alert when a settings backup fails
    • A "Settings Backup Failed" alert appears if a backup can't be saved or the chosen file isn't a DockDoor backup
  • Window previews and tracking stay more accurate for tabs you switch to
    • Happens automatically in apps with native macOS tabs

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Window switcher returns to the tab you selected
    • Applies to apps with native macOS tabs, such as Finder, Terminal, and Safari
    • Tabs you switch to are now remembered, listed in the switcher, and can be jumped to
    • Works automatically, so just switch tabs as usual
  • Switching tabs or windows in a background app no longer changes its recent order in the switcher
  • Active app indicator no longer drifts while a Dock icon bounces
    • It stays lined up with the Dock's edge with the Dock at the bottom, left, or right
    • Works automatically if you use Settings > General > Active App Indicator
  • DockDoor now launches on macOS versions that lack some of the system components used for the Liquid Glass look
    • No action needed on older macOS releases
